description: Rear: T1: Olive: Approximately 7.00m: (Larger tree): Reduce crown height by approximately 1.50m-1.70m, pruning over extended branches back into the main crown structure. Reduce lateral and sub lateral growth by up to approximately 1.20m-1.40m, ensuring ample furnishing growth is retained at branch tips to maintain naturally flowing crown profile.  Raise the crown by up to approximately 80cm, providing sufficient clearance of the building, and neighbouring property.  Thin crown density evenly throughout by approximately 20%.  Remove dead wood.  General maintenance.T2: Olive: Approximately 7.00m: (Smaller tree): Overhanging the left hand boundary. Reduce crown height by approximately 1.20m-1.40m. Reduce lateral and sub lateral growth by approximately 1.20m.  Reduce 1 x low branch which protrudes across the boundary, by approximately 2.00m to bring back into the main crown structure.  Ensure the retention of ample furnishing growth, in order to maintain crown health. Thin crown density by approximately 20%. General maintenance.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
